text:
alex: Heads up — we're seeing ~20% p95 latency regression on Mixtral-moex since the RoPE-scaling change rolled last night. Traces point at router/expert hotloops.

maria: saw it in dashboards too. KV cache miss rate spiked on the canary cluster, expert queue depth showing sustained backpressure. :eyes: 

jun: did a quick profile on a canary pod. Hot functions: Router::compute_logits, ExpertScheduler::dispatch, and memcpy hotspots from KV cache copies. Flame roughly: Router (42%), dispatch (28%), memcpy (15%).

sam: could RoPE scaling be changing attention head embeddings mapping so router entropy climbs? that would pick more experts per token => more cache churn.

alex: that's my working hypothesis — rope_scale tweak increases feature variance -> logits flatten -> more experts become eligible -> top-k routing spreads tokens wider -> cache pressure & cross-host traffic up. Also batching heuristics are aggregating slightly larger micro-batches now which amplifies tail.

maria: also noticed kernel selector falling back to generic GEMM for some QKV sizes after the change. on some A100 builds we see fallback to generic path (~+15% per-expert cost).

jun: reproduction snippet I used:
```bash
# run same traffic as canary replay
RUNTIME_ENV=canary REDWOOD_TRACE=1 ./bin/runtime --model mixtral-moex --profile 60s
```
and config excerpt:
```yaml
router:
  top_k: 2
  capacity_factor: 1.25
  logits_temp: 1.0
runtime:
  batch_size_soft: 64
  kv_cache_policy: per-expert
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started for rollout/mixtral-rope-scaling @ 1771235000 by infra (canary retained for testing).

sam: before full rollback can we try two quick knobs on canary: set top_k=1 and capacity_factor=1.0, and enable expert_local_kv_cache=true? should reduce cross-expert traffic quickly. any objections? :thinking:

maria: no objections. pushed config to canary: top_k=1, capacity_factor=1.0, expert_local_kv=true. monitoring now.

jun: early telemetry after change: p95 improved from ~360ms -> ~280ms, expert cache miss rate down ~45%. throughput for heavy prompt mix dropped ~6% (fewer experts per token -> less parallelism).

alex: if throughput drop is acceptable, keep as short-term mitigation. need to fix kernel selector so we don't hit generic GEMM fallback. @sam can you capture kernel-selection logs? set env REDWOOD_RUNTIME_KERNEL_DEBUG=1 on canary pods.

sam: on it. created ticket INF-3421 and pushed env to canary. I'll capture kernel trace and expert assignment matrices for several request shapes.

maria: adding a perf regression gate in CI for Mixtral MoE permutations (top_k, capacity_factor, rope_scale) so future rolls trigger alerts.

alex: plan: 1) keep canary with reduced top_k + local kv cache, 2) kernel selector fix (sam), 3) run synthetic replays across seq-len distribution and prompt shapes (jun), 4) decide rollback by EOD if no steady improvement. owners: kernel=sam, router/jun, observability=maria. I'll update the incident doc and ping support.

sam: quick note — we should also validate head/kv dim interactions: changed rope_scale might expose rounding that increases effective head_dim used by some optimized kernels. I'll add small microbench for head sizes 64, 80, 96 to see selector thresholds.

jun: agreed. adding microbench into perf-suite: mixtral_moe_head_bench and router_entropy_test.

alex: thanks all — keep updates concise in this thread. if anyone sees regressions on non-canary regions ping @oncall. :thumbsup:
